risk_note: RV2 by path (payment). T+1 pay reconciliation (BR-PAY-07, BR-PAY-05 ④): bill.recon job per app and +08:00 bill date; the bill is scoped to the app (downloadBill(date, appId); rows carrying another app's identity dropped); trade and refund lines against our PAID orders / SUCCESS refunds give R4 pay_mismatch (diff = expected − actual); success lines for CLOSED or unknown merchant numbers register an anomaly + PAY_ANOMALY + R4 pay_anomaly (+amount, kept consistent with B2-15c until B2-15l per D10-360); PAY_FEE per (channel, bill date) over the kept rows; terminal orders and refunds never change, no USER_BALANCE, no withdrawal hold; unavailable bills catch up hourly for 3 days then alert; no pay.channel_enabled gate; midnight window checks the previous bill. Ledger invariants db/invariants/ledger/pay-01..04 (written by the implementer, B2-02e precedent); pay- differences advise no freeze (B2-02o, merged).
